data.body:
[P2] Resolve callback names from their enclosing context

For a public `wait_for_callback` operation named `completion`, supported service histories can place the name on `ContextStarted` with `SubType="WaitForCallback"` and omit it from the child `CallbackStarted`. The base runner already handles this through `inherit_wait_for_callback_event_names`. This lookup ignores that callback indefinitely, causing the suspension scenario to time out without sending completion. Resolve unnamed callbacks through their parent context, retaining parent identities across history pages, and test the omitted-name case with the parent and child on different pages.
